name: Orlaith Faye
source:
The ward from the Fayes, the Gryms' partner family. A close friend of [url=/c146901]Cerys[/url]'s, they met during Cer's wardship with the Fayes five years ago.

Orlaith was a ward with the Cenrics last year, but left suddenly. She is now afraid to be touched by men. Cerys fears that one of [url=/c146931]Leala[/url]'s brothers abused Orlaith during her time with the Cenrics.
